api_doc_gaps.detail: INT-C.md's Interface line reads literally 'REST call — GET /api/v1/sec/registry?moduleCode={code}'. The actual implementation (src/main/java/com/erp/sec/crossmodule/SecModuleRegistryApi.java + Impl) is a direct in-process Spring interface injection, no HTTP — the same doctrine SecUserDirectoryApi already established (single-artifact monolith, pom.xml has no <modules>). The class's own javadoc names this explicitly as a documented deviation superseding INT-C.md's literal wording.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: Resolved as NAMING_MISMATCH — INT-C.md's literal REST-call wording is superseded by this project's established direct-Spring-interface-injection cross-module doctrine (SecUserDirectoryApi precedent + build-create-service skill); the real implementation (SecModuleRegistryApi, direct injection) is correct and was confirmed by the INT-C phase sub.

api_doc_gaps.detail: _SECTIONS.md's Error Catalog lists MDL-503 ('Could not verify the owning module right now') for 'SEC unreachable during XM-MDL-001's validation call'. Because XM-MDL-001 is a direct Spring-bean call (see above), not a network call, there is no 'SEC unreachable' failure mode to surface — MdlErrorCodes has no MDL_503 constant and messages.properties/messages_ar.properties have no MDL-503 key.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: Resolved as a documentation note, not a defect — MDL-503 describes a transient-network-outage scenario that cannot occur under this module's direct in-process Spring interface injection (no real network hop to SEC); a genuine DB-layer failure instead surfaces as the generic MDL-500/platform 500 path via GlobalExceptionHandler. No code change needed.

api_doc_gaps.detail: com.erp.main.config.OpenApiConfig.java declares GroupedOpenApi beans for sec, cu, notif, file only -- no mdl bean exists, despite com.erp.mdl.controller (LookupTypeController, LookupValueController, LookupConsumerController) being fully implemented. Confirmed live during the 2026-09-11 execute-backend-test run: GET /v3/api-docs/swagger-config lists only cu/file/notif/sec; GET /v3/api-docs/mdl returns 500. This blocks governance/governance-tools/api-doc-generator's discovery.match_openapi_group for --module MDL (ERROR: could not identify a unique springdoc GroupedOpenApi group), which blocks execute-backend-test.md's mandatory STEP 0.3 api-doc regeneration, which in turn blocked STEP 1 (api-verify) entirely for that run -- 0/14 REQUIRED-COVERAGE TCs could be exercised.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED -- mdlApi() GroupedOpenApi bean (group "mdl", packagesToScan "com.erp.mdl.controller") exists in com.erp.main.config.OpenApiConfig.java, following the secApi()/cuApi()/notifApi()/fileApi() pattern. Verified 2026-09-19: api-docs for MDL regenerated from the running app (11 endpoints, all carrying a Contract ID). The 2026-09-11 blocker no longer applies.
